units.source_text: 长老的话让我想起了死去的诗人托喀。

en.t: The elder's words reminded me of the dead poet Tock.

units.source_text: 不幸的是他和我一样是个无神论者。

en.t: Unfortunately, he was an atheist just like me.

units.source_text: 我不是河童，不了解生活教也可以理解了。

en.t: Since I am not a kappa, it was understandable that I did not know the Religion of Life.

units.source_text: 可是生活在河童国的托喀应该了解“生命之树”的真谛才对。

en.t: But Tock, who lived in the land of the kappa, ought to have understood the true meaning of the Tree of Life.

units.source_text: 我同情托喀不听这个真谛的指引，所以才有了这么一个结局。

en.t: I pitied Tock because he had refused to follow the guidance of this truth, and so had come to such an end.

units.source_text: 因此我打断长老的话，跟他讲述托喀的事。

en.t: So I interrupted the elder and told him about Tock.
